page_title: GEN 1-0 PAR | Genoa v Parma 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+4' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
90+4' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Parma will take a throw-in.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
89' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
89' Lior Kasa (Genoa) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but Zion Suzuki was alert and made an amazing save! Now Genoa have a corner.
86' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
84' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is repeatedly being caught offside.
84' A substitution has been made. Mandela Keita is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
83' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli makes his way off the pitch and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
79' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Morten Thorsby cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' The total number of attempts is 12:9. The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.
75' Mattia Bani (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Enrico Del Prato (Parma) duly receives a yellow card.
74' Drissa Camara (Parma) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
73' Drissa Camara (Parma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
73' Drissa Camara (Parma) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
73' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Drissa Camara (Parma) takes it short.
72' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Parma can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Fabio Pecchia prepares a substitution. Valentin Mihaila is replaced by Dennis Man (Parma).
72' The game has come to an end for Hernani. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Drissa Camara (Parma).

71' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Nicola Leali displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

69' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
67' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
65' 1 - 0 Goal! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Zion Suzuki. He makes it 1:0.
64' Lior Kasa (Genoa) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
62' Hernani (Parma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' Simon Sohm (Parma) works the corner short.
61' Simon Sohm (Parma) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
60' A clumsy foul by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle.
60' Botond Balogh (Parma) is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pecchia gives a chance to Antoine Hainaut.
60' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) on for Pontus Almqvist.
59' Mattia Bani (Genoa) sends a long ball forward to Aaron Martin, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.

57' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. A rebound falls kindly for Lior Kasa (Genoa), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
54' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle after Botond Balogh (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
53' Half-chance! Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) plays a pass into the box, but Zion Suzuki reacts well to snuff out the attack.
52' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

52' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom right corner, but Nicola Leali pulls off a great save to deny him. Parma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

48' Mattia Bani (Genoa) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
48' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will take the corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Patrick Vieira is forced to make a change. Milan Badelj (Genoa) is unable to continue due to injury, Lior Kasa comes on.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Milan Badelj (Genoa) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
44' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Hernani (Parma) sends a long ball forward to Valentin Mihaila, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
40' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nicola Leali reads it well and gathers the ball.
39' The ball is cleared after Pontus Almqvist (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
38' Referee Andrea Colombo has finally had enough of Fabio Pecchia and brandishes a yellow card at him!
38' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul. Parma have a free kick.
37' Milan Badelj (Genoa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
37' PENALTY APPEAL after Pontus Almqvist (Parma) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
36' The referee is firm and issues Hernani (Parma) a deserved yellow card.
35' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

33' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
32' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
30' Simon Sohm is picked out by Pontus Almqvist (Parma), but one of the defenders arrives to clear. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
29' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
29' Total attempts – 5:0. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
27' Milan Badelj (Genoa) gets to a rebound from the corner kick and unleashes a long-range shot. Promising try, but it goes way wide of the left post.
27' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared away by the defence.
26' A cross from Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
25' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
24' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
24' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
24' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Fabio Miretti (Genoa), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.

23' It looks like Valentin Mihaila (Parma) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Colombo won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
23' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

23' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Johan Vasquez (Genoa) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki keeps it out with an amazing save.
22' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
19' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Morten Thorsby (Genoa) offside.

19' The cross into the penalty area from Milan Badelj (Genoa) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
18' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
18' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
15' Hernani (Parma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Valentin Mihaila (Parma).
13' The resulting free kick from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Parma are going to take it.
13' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece. Parma will take a free kick near the side line.
10' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way over the bar.

8' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Morten Frendrup (Genoa) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

7' The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Lautaro Valenti (Parma) the culprit. Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
4' Milan Badelj (Genoa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
4' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Zion Suzuki is well positioned and punches the ball away.
4' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
2' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) brings an opponent down and Andrea Colombo interrupts the game.
1' The first half has just begun.

The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
